full_public_input.native_graph_preprocessing: Reuse qualified complete provider graph with existing loops; add no loops, symmetry, topology deletions or kNN edges.
full_public_input.attribute_incidence: B_ij=1[X_ij>0] from full permitted raw binary features; no labels/prediction errors in B. D=diag(max(row_counts,1))^-1 B; C=diag(max(column_counts,1))^-1 B^T. Zero rows/columns give zero outputs. Same B,C,D in every arm; sparse store, no materialized N-by-N feature graph.
full_public_input.information: Full transductive X and original graph common to all arms. Deterministic incidence adds computational paths, no newly observed information or labels.

role_geometry: Custodian stratifies each fresh mask: per class20 TRAIN,30 SELECT,30 CAL; remainder DEVELOPMENT_EVAL. Totals100/150/150/34093. IDs/order common to all ten arms within a block. New role protocols are developmental on an already encountered graph, not unused task confirmation.
no_actual_array_or_incidence_payload_has: No payload accessed. Root must bind full X, adjacency, degrees, C/D, every safe role artifact and actual provider/runtime/resource receipts before construction/execution. Incidence must be built once from full raw undropped X, never labels or route states.

source_recipe.native_layer: Use the same dropped input for aggregate and skip: z=mean_A(Drop(h) Wagg)+Drop(h) Wskip+b; clip each row by max(L2 norm,1); first layer ReLU only; final logits also clipped.
source_recipe.input: Raw binary X, no feature normalization. Input dropout acts on stored sparse values, keeps indices including zeros. Each route own persistent IID masks; same route mask feeds its aggregate and skip.
source_recipe.optimizer: Explicit source TF1 Adam port LR .001,beta1 .9,beta2 .999,eps1e-8 before bias correction, float32 beta powers as state. All active groups updated once per complete objective; no extra feedback optimizer/schedule.
source_recipe.penalty: .05 times first-layer aggregate+skip squared effective weights; ordinary P1/PA1 use ordinary matrices. For shared arms average squared effective weights over four routes. Genuine I4 each has full own penalty. Feedback B/V unpenalized in all equipped arms, no added objective.
source_recipe.selector: Latest tied minimum total SELECT CE+native/effective L2; evaluate after each update; 50 strictly worse consecutive totals or 100000 updates. Joint banks use mean total. Genuine I4 each own selector/stop. Restore full selected model/optimizer/all RNG.
source_recipe.factorization: Each aggregate/skip W has separate learned private input r and output s; W_eff=diag(r) W diag(s). All native layer biases private per route. W shared only in S4/SA4/SM4/SX4. r/s start independent Rademacher +/-1; W Glorot uniform, bias0. Extra factor optimization changes the source learner; source P1 and F1 must remain separate competence controls.

factory_initialization: CPU W Glorot via block+1000003*body_index inside fork/CPU-only seed. Factors use independent CPU per-route seeds block+281000033+1000003*m. Feedback uses dedicated CPU seed block+281000039+1000003*m and zero V. Global CPU RNG restored; no constructor CUDA stream seeding. Root owns persistent native dropout streams and all restore custody.
caller_model_count: I4/IA4: four separate M1 objects/optimizers/selectors. UX4: one joint model with four disjoint bodies and four feedback maps, one mean own optimizer/selector. Shared bank: one slow body, four factors/biases, one map pair.

costs.incidence_nnz: S=nnz(B); not inspected. Public dimensions only, upper S<=290258595.
costs.candidate_increment: One forward adds2*M*S*h=256*S scalar sparse MACs for M4/h32 plus2*M*F*h*r=34467840 dense MACs, clipping/nonlinearity, donor mixing and memory. Each TRAIN derivative/backward and every SELECT/CAL/DEVEVAL coupled forward charged. B construction/normalization, factor effective regularizer and export/calibration count. No N-by-N feature adjacency or top-k search.
costs.candidate_intermediate: U,phi(U),T: each M*F*h=1077120 FP32 scalars; each ~4.31MB. Hprime: M*N*h=4415104 scalars ~17.66MB, plus tape/native states/optimizer/sparse incidence and reductions. Real peak must be measured.
costs.parameter_scope: Trainable storage only, not peak/acquisition cost. Four separate feedback maps for UX4, one shared feedback map for SX4. Factor arrays counted for both matrices each layer; private biases37/route.
costs.planning_limit: Unqualified broad planning envelope, not ETA or source/runtime admission. Incidence nnz, optimizer horizons and peak are unknown. Root must bind finite limits and actual full-input qualification; record incomplete budgets as failures, never promote a partial panel. No timing obtained from old overlapped90-fit cohort is a speed benchmark.

forward_autograd: Live C/D/phi donor paths, no detach/no_grad. Complete joint forward required for SX4/SM4/UX4; no member-at-a-time serving after coupling.
